verdict.rationale: Angular's first-party site explicitly offers "completely in browser tutorial lessons designed to give you hands on experience with Angular" (angular-docs-5). The installation docs also point newcomers to a no-setup browser playground (angular-docs-8), so the core story is clearly delivered. Missing for 10: detail on tutorial scope and lesson content, a description of the interactive editor experience, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the tutorial works without local setup.
